title: Book Three · Chapter 1: The Seat Beside Him
story:
Ronan puts his school sheet beside his breakfast bowl.

He checks the time once. Then he puts the sheet in his bag. He knows the way to the new building. He walked there with Mum and Dad yesterday.

Dad is already at work. Mum is folding a coat near the window.

“Do you need me at the gate?” she asks.

“No. I can find it.”

“Good. Then I can finish this before the customer comes.”

She holds up the coat. One sleeve hangs lower than the other.

“Is that right?” Ronan asks.

“The coat is sideways. My customer has two arms the same length.”

Mum turns it straight. Ronan smiles and takes his bag.

The blue bike stays in the yard. This morning he will walk. He touches the old bell once, but does not ring it.

Outside, Mr Qiu is opening a box of pencils.

“First day?”

“Yes.”

“Then take your own pencil. These are still for sale.”

“I have two.”

“Enough for two first days.”

Ronan walks toward the school. At the wide corner, he looks down the other street. Leo leaves for the other city today. There is no familiar bag beside his own.

A cart passes. Ronan waits, then crosses.

At the new gate, older students move past him in small groups. Some call to each other. One boy carries a ball under his shirt. His friend tells him to stand straight.

Ronan laughs quietly. Then he follows the path to his building.

His classroom is upstairs. He finds the number on the door and goes in.

A few students are already talking near the front. Ronan chooses a desk beside the window. There are two chairs.

He puts his bag on the floor. Then he moves the other chair a little.

Leo always needs more room for his feet.

Ronan keeps his hand on the chair. Leo is not coming through this door.

He sits down and takes out his notebook.

A boy at the next desk turns around.

“Do you know anyone here?”

“Not yet.”

“Only one. Over there.”

The boy points toward the front. His friend calls to him. He turns away again. Ronan looks out at the yard.

At his old school, he knew the voices outside the window. Here he can hear a whistle and several new names.

A girl comes between the desks. Her bag catches on a chair back. She stops, lifts the strap, and frees it.

“Is this seat taken?” she asks.

Ronan looks at the chair beside him. His first thought is Leo's name.

“No,” he says. “You can sit here.”

“Thank you.”

She puts her bag down. Ronan moves his notebook to his own half of the desk.

The teacher comes in with a pile of papers. The room grows quieter. Ronan sits straight.

Beside him, the girl takes out a pencil. It rolls toward his book.

He stops it with one finger and gives it back.

“First escape,” she whispers.

Ronan smiles. Then the teacher begins to call their names.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

seat taken＝座位被占用；strap＝带子；whistle＝哨声；escape＝逃走（这里玩笑指铅笔滚走）。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么会下意识地挪动旁边的椅子？
2. 新女生问座位时，他最后怎样回应？

## 读句子

**He puts his bag on the floor.**

拆开看：He / puts his bag / on the floor.

他／把书包放下／放在地上。
